name: [ROCKET LAUNCHER] Tank Game Simulator
desc:
💥Play Tank Game Simulator and compete with other players to become the strongest tank💥
 
👍 Join the group to receive 1 free daily revive upon logging in 👍

🔺Destroy shapes and tanks to grow stronger🔺
🔵 Evolve into different tank classes that best suit your playstyle 🔵
😎 Buy cosmetics to personalize your tank 😎
🏆 Over 50 badges to unlock 🏆

Three evolution stages! Pick your tank and evolve from levels 15, 30 and 45
PC users can quickly allocate skill points through keys 1-9. Keyboard shortcuts: Q = Inventory, E = Shop, R = Stats, G = Gifts
If you have 1+ skill points in shield, press F on PC to activate or use the shield button on mobile. Shift to turbo
Join the group!

Premium Benefits: 3 FREE crates of each type and PERMANENT cash multiplier
